<b>Arrastar:</b> arrasta uma nota para o: Drag: drag a note to the instant in the recording where it should play (snaps to the beat). The notes between two corrections stretch/compress to follow. Ideal for fixing a spot that slipped.
<b>Marcar no cursor:</b> dá play, e quan: Mark at cursor: press play, and when you hear a note in the recording, click that note on the score — it anchors at the cursor position. Align while playing.
<b>Excerto:</b> arrasta uma caixa por ci: Excerpt: drag a box over several notes and then drag one of them — they all move as a block. (Alternative: Shift+click one note and another to select the range.)
<b>Mover seguintes:</b> pausa a gravação: Move following: pause the recording at the right instant and click the 1st misaligned note — that note and ALL the following ones move as a block to the cursor. For a whole passage that came in late/early.
<b>Corrigir daqui (detetar andamento) —: Fix from here (detect tempo) — the recommended mode: listen up to the point where the score starts drifting from the recording and click that note. It measures the recording's real BPM from there on and re-spaces only the following notes. Nothing before the click moves, so what was already right stays intact. Repeat whenever it drifts again — each correction starts from where the previous one left off.
<b>Alinhar por compasso:</b> pausa a gra: Align bar: pause the recording at the right instant and click a note — or the bar line/number, to align it by its start even without notes — a popup opens with that bar already chosen. Confirm with "= cursor" and that bar aligns to the cursor (or "= track" for the same bar of another track). Do it several times along the song; each correction carries the following notes along. In the same popup, Tempo changes the BPM of that bar (or of several in a row) and the rest of the song follows, each bar keeping its own tempo.
<b>Mudança de tom:</b> clica numa nota p: Tone change: click a note to switch to one of the extra tones from there on.
<b>Secção:</b> clica numa nota para nome: Section: click a note to name where a section starts (intro/verse/chorus…). Nothing to do with sync — it's for navigation and Riff Repeater.
<b>Editar notas:</b> clica numa nota par: Edit notes: click a note to edit it (fret, sustain, techniques, bend/slide) or remove it; double-click on empty staff inserts a new note, snapped to the grid. A single click on empty space moves the cursor, as in the other modes. It changes the CONTENT of the score — it stays pending until "Apply and rebuild".
No mode active. Click a mode above. Tip: for a uniform offset across the whole passage, use Tempo (BPM) instead — it needs no anchors.
